en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a general view of a large institutional building partially obscured by bare trees, likely taken in winter or early spring. The building complex is labeled 'Pensionnat de Spermalie', and the setting appears formal and serene, with neat rows of trees and a landscaped garden or park in the foreground. The postcard includes printed French text at the bottom and a handwritten name or signature ('Ludwine') in the lower right corner.
